actions.name: elemental demise
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies, its body disintegrates in a flash of fire and puff of smoke, leaving behind only equipment the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} was wearing or carrying.

actions.name: innate spellcasting
actions.desc: The efreeti's innate spell casting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: [[/item .ghXTfe7sgCbgf1Q8]]{detect magic} 3/day: [[/item .WahI41a3goVUg0x1]]{enlarge/reduce}, [[/item .gopnZvS0c2jD5FP8]]{tongues} 1/day each: conjure elemental (fire elemental only), [[/item .2IWiZAJtOGDoKjiz]]{gaseous form}, [[/item .1N8dDMMgZ1h1YJ3B]]{invisibility}, [[/item .nslx2nT3p4lNkmdp]]{major image}, [[/item .J6Jpw5XzB5aTeqnz]]{plane shift}, [[/item .X3DrXgxjwI2dvkD6]]{wall of fire}

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item .tR7JGJjIz6H1oerb]]{scimitar} attacks or uses its [[/item .9D7vAr8iJbSa4g5N]]{Hurl Flame} twice.
